method: Actual production TLS edge reached through loopback DNS with normal certificate validation and original Host/SNI. Other paths use loopback HTTP. Keep-alive; three warmups excluded; 21 sequential samples per backend/case with rotated order. Timings include complete body transfer and exclude hash calculation. Payload hashes/encoding match. Before/after edge runs use the same TLS protocol and URL; no WAN, browser rendering or cold-disk measurement. Normal traffic and visit logging may add noise.
